bio.text: Chrissy Houlahan represents Pennsylvania's 6th Congressional District in the U.S. House and is the first woman to hold the seat.
She earned an engineering degree from Stanford on an ROTC scholarship, served in the U.S. Air Force and Air Force Reserves, and later earned an M.S. in Technology and Policy from MIT.
Before Congress she worked at companies including AND1 and B Lab, taught chemistry through Teach for America in Philadelphia, and led an education nonprofit.
